summary:
w233 plan, supervision#r211. Both examples (before, after) of the r211 Outline fail at the first Given: no step accepts the trailing ', given <when> i1 started'.
Change: one new Given in tests/scenarios/supervision_delegation_steps.py. For 'before' it writes the delegation with the started initiative; for 'after' it commits the initiative and q1 with no delegation, then adds the delegation in a later commit. It sets context["delegation"] and leaves the existing step's pattern unchanged.
No production change: supervise_answers.Answers.delegation already reads the request live on every work run.
No existing test broken. Open: later steps (1377-1381) not yet run; a delegation changed or removed after start is not covered by the scenarios.
